capabilities: Fill template notes with structured JSON through MCP tools or REST routes
Format table fields as aligned GFM tables with escaped pipes and filled empty cells
Ingest images and attachments from local paths, vault files or Base64 into the attachment folder
Render templates to Obsidian Markdown or Telegram HTML channels
Validate input and report which field failed and how to fix the call
disambiguation: Not AI text generation; the agent only supplies JSON and the deterministic Liquid engine renders the output.
extras: Desktop only (uses Node.js filesystem APIs); makes no network calls except the optional one-click AI Ecosystem installer; starter templates ship in English or Portuguese; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin registers its tools and routes in the ai-ecosystem plugin.
motivation: The author built it because agents writing Markdown directly spend hundreds of output tokens on formatting and misalign table columns.
problem: AI agents writing long Markdown or tables directly waste output tokens on formatting, misalign columns, forget to escape pipes and struggle with binary attachments.
